desc: Formalize prime-wise decomposition and prove that the global gcd condition is equivalent to every prime exponent walk having minimum \(0\).
Derive and implement the first-zero prefix/suffix DP with correct boundary transitions and \(p^{e_i}\) weighting.
Aggregate per-prime sums, factor all \(A_i\), and handle primes absent from every \(A_i\).
Verify the corrected implementation against all three provided samples.
Confirm modular arithmetic, complexity, exponent bounds, and edge-case handling.
